title: Continual Test-Time Adaptation via Entropy Sensitivity-Guidance in Strict Online Setting
abstract: arXiv:2608.29920v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Test-time adaptation (TTA) promises robustness under distribution shift by updating a pretrained model on unlabeled test data, but strict online TTA with batch size one and no access to source data is especially prone to drift or collapse. We introduce Sensitivity-Guided Erasing Adaptation (SEGA), a method for strict online continual TTA (CTTA) on corruption-style streams. SEGA uses a small number of structured erasures to probe how predictive entropy changes as information is removed, and uses the resulting per-sample sensitivity trajectories to coordinate recovery and sample selection rather than relying on raw entropy or batch statistics. This yields a practical feedback signal for long-horizon batch-size-one adaptation without periodic resets or model reservoirs. In experiments on ImageNet-C, CIFAR10/100-C, and corruption-generated aquaculture streams treated as controlled corruption-style proxies, SEGA yields consistent robustness

translated_title: 严格在线设置下基于熵敏感性引导的持续测试时自适应
translated_abstract: 测试时自适应（TTA）通过在无标签测试数据上更新预训练模型，有望在分布偏移下实现鲁棒性，但批大小为一且无法访问源数据的严格在线TTA尤其容易出现漂移或崩溃。我们提出了敏感性引导擦除自适应（SEGA），这是一种针对腐蚀风格数据流的严格在线持续TTA（CTTA）方法。SEGA使用少量结构化擦除来探测预测熵如何随信息的移除而变化，并利用由此产生的逐样本敏感性轨迹来协调恢复和样本选择，而不是依赖原始熵或批量统计信息。这为长期批大小为一的自适应提供了实用的反馈信号，无需周期性重置或模型储备库。在ImageNet-C、CIFAR10/100-C以及作为受控腐蚀风格代理的腐蚀生成水产养殖数据流上的实验中，SEGA展现出一致的鲁棒性。
tldr: SEGA通过结构化擦除探测预测熵的敏感性变化，利用逐样本敏感性轨迹协调恢复与样本选择，实现了无需周期性重置或模型储备库的严格在线持续测试时自适应。
en_tdlr: SEGA probes predictive entropy sensitivity through structured erasures and uses per-sample sensitivity trajectories to coordinate recovery and sample selection, enabling strict online continual test-time adaptation without periodic resets or model reservoirs.
